video_review.reviewer: Codex /root/scenarios/refs_workspaces; inline full PNGs, paired terminal JSON and sampled MP4 contact sheet
video_review.summary: Sampled review, not a real-time watch: 16 evenly spaced frames across 22.73 seconds show held scratch preview, cancel, reopen/confirm, actual successful update, scoped green KEEP-ME addition/red README deletion and a second already-current update. Corrected captions now transition from Cancel first to Confirm the update to synchronize scratch while retaining its local work, then Scratch is synchronized; inspect the changed files next. The stale cancellation caption no longer persists after confirmation. Semantic waits and 2-3 second teaching holds make the sequence readable; no fixture setup appears. Six passing assertions prove retained registrations and local/default files, applied rewritten tree, updated description and successful scratch status. Reviewed exact fourth-CI bytes supersede the third-CI editorial hold.
